text_block_list.text:
It was—by no means an event confined 
solely to the world of Umamusume.

It was so sudden, so unexpected, and an 
event on far too massive a scale.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan, about next 
week's schedule...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ââ!? This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Everyone, get down--!!

How much time had passed since then? 
During all that long while...

Everyone was desperate just to protect and 
maintain themselves. Humans and Umamusume 
alike... without exception.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan... Are you okay...!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, somehow! What about you, Tran?!
Yeah, somehow! How about you, Tran!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All fine here, too... Has the emergency 
power... still not kicked on?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainy, the epicenter is...

I quickly pulled out my smartphone and 
combed through the currently available 
information.

The media was in complete chaos as well. 
Even so, the breaking news revealed the 
epicenter of it all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh... No way...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "That place...? Then..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(No way... That can't be real... It can't 
be... No...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure... everything will be fine. 
I'm... sure...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan! I'll be right over—!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still...!!
choice_data_list:
Public transportation is probably shut 
down too. And besides...

text_block_list.text:
Even if by some miracle I could reach 
them... Right now, I'd just be in the way.

"If civilians act on emotion, it will only 
hinder rescue operations."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Understood... Trainer-chan... Then...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll wait until a request comes into our 
usual volunteer group before taking 
action.

From the next day onward— desperate relief 
efforts continued across the north.

The Umamusume of Tracen Academy also 
helped where they could, contributing to 
the effort.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I finally made it here. But...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's crumbling in places... How awful... 
This is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Is everyone... okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Northern Children
text_block_list.text: Ah... Tora-chan... Tora-chaaaan...!!

It took quite a while... for things to 
settle down.

Before long, Tracen Academy gradually 
returned to its everyday routine, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, I think we've overcome... the 
biggest hurdle for now. But...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the end, is it? From here on, 
an even longer time will...

A massive rift was torn into the lives of 
those who were close to Transcend...

How many years will it take to rebuild the 
foundations of everyday life?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Even so... I've gotta do what I can.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I want to do whatever I can to help.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's strength isn't just meant 
for running.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
At a time like this... That's right, isn't 
it?
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, I'll figure something out with 
the training schedule.

...Yeah, I'll work out a way to manage our 
training time.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

Afterward, Transcend found herself 
bustling about with volunteer work even 
more than before...

Between training sessions, she began to 
spend more time standing dazed in silence.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What is this feeling...? My heart... just 
won't settle down...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I am... running. Right? I am, aren't I? 
But somehow..."

An unprecedented disaster that completely 
altered the atmosphere of the country. 
Because of it, Transcend's sense of values 
was shaken to its core.
